law: REGISTRATION of E-Q30 — compositional 16-bit retrieval (ORCH-R26 lane T17-c, the prior-art pass open question Q5): does the E-Q26 FAMILY ALGEBRA survive quantization? E-Q26 measured perfect family-level analogy (5/5) in the dense noul space; E-Q27 quantized the same vectors to ternary (16-bit) and 4-level codes. If code-space composition (saturation arithmetic on the E-Q27 codes, retrieved by code matching) also lands in the target family, then a 16-bit code plus an operator IS a family query — storage and query collapse into the same object (queries AS storage). ZERO new embed calls.
provenance_of_the_question: EMBEDDER-PRIOR-ART Q5 (compositional/logical retrieval over typed axes) crossed with the E-Q26 AM2 third direction (5/5 family algebra, offsets carry ~2 bits of family geometry) and the E-Q27 quantization curves (ST 0.60 / NQ 0.70 retrieval). Nobody in the learning-to-hash literature composes QUERIES by arithmetic on ternary QA-codes — the literature is binary codes at 100s-1000s bits, matched by Hamming, never composed. If composition survives the quantization floor, the ternary QA-code is not just storage (E-Q27) but a query LANGUAGE.

design_frozen.data: The sealed E-Q27 code tables (situations/embedding_r25/eq27_results.json: arms ST ternary-score, SQ 4-level-score, NT ternary-noul, NQ 4-level-noul, all 20 records x 8 axes) and the E-Q26 frozen compositions (the SAME five analogy tuples a-b+c->d, byte-identical selection rule).
design_frozen.composition: For each analogy tuple and each code arm: composed = clip(code(a) - code(b) + code(c), arm range) — elementwise, saturation at the arm's code bounds ({-1,0,+1} for ternary, {-1.5,-0.5,+0.5,+1.5} for 4-level). Clipping incidence reported per arm (P4's measure).
design_frozen.retrieval_local: For each composed code: strict rank by cosine over the 20 corpus codes of the same arm (self-components a,b,c included as candidates — the composed vector is NOT a corpus member, so no self-exclusion applies; the E-Q26 scoring convention). Family hit = top-1 code's family == family(d).
design_frozen.retrieval_live: The composed codes queried LIVE against the eq27ST / eq27SQ / eq27NT / eq27NQ arms already resident in qthe-jev-embed (arm-filtered topK 20, zero-padded to 32 dims). The live number is the receipt of record; local==live deltas reported.
design_frozen.null: The E-Q26 permutation null discipline: 1000 label-permutation draws (seed 20261026, fixed), recomputing code-space family hits per draw — the code-space null is NOT assumed to equal the dense null (quantization changes the geometry).
design_frozen.baselines: Majority family baseline 0.25 per family-draw; the dense-space result 5/5 (E-Q26 AM2) as the ceiling reference.

floors.F1: codes recomputed from the sealed E-Q27 quantization tables (byte-identical rules), not re-derived from raw rows
floors.F2: the five analogy tuples byte-identical to the sealed E-Q26 compositions
floors.F3: live retrieval through the index, arm-filtered, for every composed code
floors.F4: the null computed on the pre-committed seed BEFORE the live numbers are read off

hypotheses.H1_algebra_survives: ternary-composed family hits >= 4/5 on the live retrieval (the algebra survives 16-bit quantization)
hypotheses.H2_resolution_pays: 4-level family hits >= ternary family hits (resolution helps algebra as it helped retrieval in E-Q27) — OR the inversion: ternary > 4-level because offset arithmetic is cleanest on {-1,0,+1} (either direction is a finding; the clause is the COMPARISON, pre-registered both ways)
hypotheses.H3_above_baseline: both code arms beat the majority baseline 0.25 by >= 2x on family hit rate
hypotheses.C26: the 16-bit code is a queryable index — composed codes retrieve families, storage = query — LIVES iff H1 AND H3

predictions.P3: both arms >= 0.50 family hit rate vs null p95 reported alongside
predictions.P4: clipping binds on <= 8 of 40 composed coordinates (the offsets are small — the E-Q26 autopsy showed residual deltas well inside code range)
predictions.P5: the code-space null is TIGHTER than the dense null (quantized geometry has fewer near-ties: fewer accidental family hits under permutation)

falsifier: ANY of F1-F4 breached; a composition tuple re-chosen after seeing results; the null seeded after the live read; a family hit claimed from local numbers where the live number disagrees (live governs).
budget: ZERO new embed calls. Free-tier CF queries only. Part of the r26 round budget.
